body:
From MMR-34 (accepted), for multi-day play:
- **Encounters.** The startup audit's gameplay window (2 days) and the save travel set `MobileParty.MainParty.IgnoreByOtherPartiesTill`, because the probes play no encounters. Run 39908 stalled when looters engaged the waiting player. Run 31864 showed that entering a town without an encounter breaks the town menu. Encounters, raids and bandit pressure are untested on generated worlds.
- **Bandit scale.** `DefaultBanditDensityModel` keeps Calradia-scale constants: 270 looter parties, 7 initial and 9 maximum infested hideouts per bandit faction. A small world fills fewer hideouts; check the pressure is sane.
- **Incidents.** `IncidentsCampaignBehaviour`'s kingdom-id checks (sturgia, khuzait, aserai, empire, vlandia) are never true on generated worlds, so those incidents never fire.
- **Wanderers.** The wanderer introduction was verified on the map with a stand-in conversation agent, up to the tavern-mission read (`CampaignMission.Current.Location`). A real tavern conversation is untested.
- **Villagers.** In the startup world's 2-day window no natural villager party moved; the other world had 31 checks.
